page_title: GEN 2-0 VEN | Genoa v Venezia 17/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:7.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Mirko Maric (Venezia) is adjudged offside.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Pinamonti departs the field of play to be replaced by Jean Onana (Genoa).

86' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 2:0. Ionut Radu was helpless.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Issa Doumbia (Venezia) replacing Kike Perez.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) comes onto the pitch so that Mikael Egill Ellertsson can be given a rest.
82' 1 - 0 Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) receives a precise pass inside the box from Caleb Ekuban and he beats the goalkeeper with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 1:0.
80' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
78' The foul by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
76' A corner kick by Venezia is thwarted by the well prepared Nicola Leali (Genoa).

75' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Venezia have a corner.
73' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
73' Substitution. Junior Messias did his best and is replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).

72' A big opportunity is wasted by Aaron Martin (Genoa), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Ionut Radu pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
72' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
71' Kike Perez (Venezia) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
69' It is time for a substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) is on for Gaetano Oristanio.
68' Venezia fail to score from a corner as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.

67' A pass lands at the feet of Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Venezia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Venezia.
62' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Livio Marinelli saw the whole situation.
60' Problems for Patrick Vieira as Vitinha is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) replaces him.
60' Vitinha (Genoa) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Daniel Fila and he is replaced by Mirko Maric (Venezia).
57' Substitution. Francesco Zampano leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Busio (Venezia).
57' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) hits a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper denies his promising shot by diving and punching the ball clear. Top class save.
53' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Vitinha (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.

51' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
51' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will take a corner kick.
50' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Genoa.
47' A corner kick by Venezia is thwarted by the well prepared Nicola Leali (Genoa).

47' Kike Perez (Venezia) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Good work from Venezia as they win a corner.
46' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Livio Marinelli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Venezia are awarded a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' Kike Perez (Venezia) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
43' Venezia fail to score from a corner as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.

42' A nice pass finds Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top of the net, but Nicola Leali pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Venezia win a corner kick.
40' Flag goes up against Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Livio Marinelli signals a set piece.
35' Junior Messias (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
33' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
31' Junior Messias (Genoa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ionut Radu intercepts the ball.
30' Foul! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
29' 2:10 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.

26' This was a piece of cake for Nicola Leali. Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
25' A crossfield pass from Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
23' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
22' Aaron Martin (Genoa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
21' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes a short corner kick.

18' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Venezia.
15' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Kike Perez (Venezia) for his blatant foul.
14' Junior Messias (Genoa) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.

12' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
11' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mattia Bani (Genoa) was quite harsh and Livio Marinelli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
10' Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.
9' Vitinha (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Francesco Zampano (Venezia) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
4' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
4' Junior Messias (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now Genoa have a corner.
3' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Venezia will have the kick-off.
